sql: SELECT substr(t.txn_date,1,4) year,c.category_name,SUM(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*t.[unit_selling_px_rmb/kg]) raw_revenue,SUM(CAST(ROUND(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*1000) AS INTEGER)*CAST(ROUND(t.[unit_selling_px_rmb/kg]*100) AS INTEGER)) scaled_integer_revenue,(SUM(CAST(ROUND(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*1000) AS INTEGER)*CAST(ROUND(t.[unit_selling_px_rmb/kg]*100) AS INTEGER))+500)/1000/100.0 integer_half_up_revenue,SUM(ABS(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*1000-ROUND(t.[qty_sold(kg)]*1000))>0.00001) qty_precision_violations,SUM(ABS(t.[unit_selling_px_rmb/kg]*100-ROUND(t.[unit_selling_px_rmb/kg]*100))>0.00001) px_precision_violations FROM veg_txn_df t JOIN veg_cat c ON t.item_code=c.item_code WHERE t.[sale/return]='sale' GROUP BY year,c.category_name
